I’m sorry—I don’t have live internet access, so I can’t pull in today’s actual weather conditions for San Francisco.  

If you’d like an estimate based on typical patterns:

| Season | Typical Temperature Range | Common Weather |
|--------|---------------------------|---------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | ~48°F – 58°F (9°C – 14°C) | Mostly cloudy; occasional fog; light rain possible |
| Spring (Mar–May) | ~55°F – 68°F (13°C – 20°C) | Sunny mornings, cooler evenings; some breezy days |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | ~60°F – 75°F (16°C – 24°C) | Warm afternoons, cool nights; coastal breeze often keeps it comfortable |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | ~57°F – 70°F (14°C – 21°C) | Generally sunny; temperatures gradually drop toward winter |

For the most accurate, up‑to‑date forecast, check a trusted weather service such as NOAA, AccuWeather, or your favorite smartphone app.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
